scripts.translation: 我。我會讓你擁有隻有我能打造的飾品，讓你盡顯天使的優雅或惡魔的魅力。

scripts.text: I'm always here at this scenic spot so I can enjoy the view. Just come back whenever you feel like it.
scripts.translation: 我一直在這個風景優美的地方，可以欣賞美景。你想什麼時候回來都行。

scripts.translation: 做帽子的材料你都帶齊了，可身上的東西太多，拿不下了。先把一些物品存進卡普拉倉庫吧？

scripts.text: put this down on the ground...

scripts.text: ^FF0000Then, suddenly with a dazzling light, the Raccoon Hat turned blue and slowly transformed into a Sea-Otter Hat.^000000
scripts.translation: 接著，突然閃過一道耀眼的光芒，狸貓帽變成了藍色，並慢慢變成了一頂海獺帽。 ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: I made this hat with all my heart, so you gotta promise me you will take care of this, okay?
scripts.translation: 這頂帽子是我用心製作的，所以你一定要答應我好好珍惜它，好嗎？

scripts.text: Um, I know! How about I make you a cute, warm and fuzzy Sea-Otter hat?
scripts.translation: 啊，有了！給你做一頂可愛又暖和、毛茸茸的海獺帽，怎麼樣？

scripts.text: It's really really cute! Also, it's the only hat I know how to make, because I love playing with Sea Otters so much!
scripts.translation: 它真的超級可愛！而且，這是我唯一會做的帽子，因為我非常喜歡和海獺玩耍！

scripts.text: I have to put together ^0000FF1 Raccoon Hat^000000 and ^0000FF1 Smokie Leaf^000000 to make a ^4D4DFFSea-Otter Hat^000000 for you, though.

scripts.text: Cool~! Come back soon as you can~!
Well, it's supposed to be a seeeecret, but my mommy taught me some magic to make Sea-Otter hats with Raccoon hats.
scripts.translation: 雖然這本來是個秘密啦，但我媽媽教了我一種魔法，可以用狸貓帽做出海獺帽。

scripts.text: It's the bestest magic ever because it comes from my heart!
scripts.translation: 這是最棒的魔法，因為它出自我的真心！

scripts.text: Hey hey! Can I make you a Sea-Otter hat! It's really really really really cute!
scripts.translation: 嘿~！我可以給你做一頂海獺帽嗎？它真的超級超級可愛！

scripts.text: I need ^0000FF1 Raccoon Hat^000000 and ^0000FF1 Smokie Leaf^000000 so I can make a ^4D4DFFSea-Otter Hat^000000 for you.

scripts.text: Okay, I will come back with the stuff.

scripts.text: Um, why do you want to make hats so much?
scripts.translation: 嗯，你為什麼這麼想做帽子？

scripts.text: If everyone in Lutie was wearing a fuzzy Sea-Otter cap, it would look so so cute!
scripts.translation: .！要是薑餅城的每個人都戴著毛茸茸的海獺帽，那一定超級超級可愛！

scripts.text: We could play games in the snow, and play with real Sea Otters and have them give us rides and...
scripts.translation: 我們可以在雪地裡玩，和真正的海獺一起玩，讓它們馱著我們... .

scripts.text: You brought every material I need, but unfortunately you don't have enough space in your inventory. Try and place some of your items into Kafra Storage first.
scripts.translation: 你帶來了所有材料，可惜物品欄空間不夠。先把一些物品存進卡普拉倉庫吧。

scripts.text: Excellent! You brought everything! Please make yourself comfortable while I make you your Teddybear Hat.
scripts.translation: 太好了！你帶來了所有材料！請坐好，我要開始為你製作小熊帽了。

scripts.text: There is an old saying, 'Everything comes to those who wait.' Oh, are you freezing? Why don't you rub your hands together?
scripts.translation: 常言道，好東西值得耐心等。哦，冷了嗎？搓搓手暖和一下吧。

scripts.text: It's complete! There you go. I think this one will look really good on you! Please take good care of this hat.
scripts.translation: 完成了！給你。我覺得這頂帽子戴在你頭上一定很好看！請好好珍惜這頂帽子。

scripts.text: What brings you to Lutie, town of goodwill and year round Christmas cheer?
scripts.translation: 麼風把你吹到薑餅城來了？這裡充滿善意，一年到頭都有聖誕氣氛。

scripts.text: I'm a master of creating stuffed animals, which make great presents. As we all know, everyone loves to hug cute and cuddly stuffed animals.
scripts.translation: 我是製作毛絨玩具的大師，它們是很棒的禮物。眾所周知，大家都喜歡抱著可愛又柔軟的毛絨玩具。

scripts.text: My specialty is the 'Teddybear Hat.' When it's worn, it makes you as cute as a teddy bear, and your hugs twice as warm and cuddly.
scripts.translation: 我的拿手活兒，是“小熊帽”。戴上它，你就像泰迪熊一樣可愛，連擁抱都能暖上兩倍，讓人更想依偎。

scripts.text: The 'Teddybear Hat' can't be worn by just anyone, since it's cuddling powers are easily abused.
scripts.translation: “小熊帽”並非人人都能戴，因為它的擁抱力量很容易被濫用。

scripts.text: But I sense that you are an adventurer with a pure heart and would not use the Teddybear Hat for selfish gain.
scripts.translation: 但我感覺到你擁有一顆純淨的心，不會為了私利而濫用小熊帽。

scripts.text: You can learn a lot about telling good people from the naughty after working for Santa for a loooong time...
scripts.translation: 給聖誕老人工作這麼多年，我早就學會分辨乖孩子和調皮鬼了...

scripts.text: I sense that you are an adventurer with a good heart, and that a sweet girl like you deserves a nice gift.
scripts.translation: 我感覺到你是一位心地善良的冒險者，像你這樣甜美的女孩值得擁有一份美好的禮物。

scripts.text: You know more about such things after working for Santa for so long.
scripts.translation: 在為聖誕老人工作這麼久之後，我對這些事情瞭解得更多。

scripts.text: Unfortunately, I don't have any material to make the headgear right now. But if you bring the materials, I will make you a 'Teddybear Hat' for free.
scripts.translation: 不幸的是，我現在沒有製作頭飾的材料。但如果你帶來材料，我會免費為你製作一頂“小熊帽”。

scripts.text: So, do you think you can get all of them? I will be here waiting for you.
scripts.translation: 那麼，你覺得你能找到所有這些東西嗎？我會在這裡等你。

scripts.text: You look like you're having trouble carrying all of your things. Why don't you place some of your extra items into the Kafra Storage?

scripts.text: Ah, I can tell that you already have a ^8C1717'Model Training Hat'^000000. I see that using it has corrected your posture.
scripts.translation: 我看得出你已經有一頂“矯正姿勢之帽”。看來戴它確實改善了你的姿勢。 ^8C1717^000000

scripts.text: I forgot to tell you that I can not only put together a 'Model Training Hat,' I can disassemble it into its original parts.
scripts.translation: ..我忘了告訴你，我不僅能組裝“矯正姿勢之帽”，還能將其拆解回原始部件。

scripts.text: If you give me ^0000FF1 'Model Training Hat'^000000 and ^0000FF1 'Arrow'^000000, I give you ^8C17171 'Apple of Archer'^000000 and ^8C17171 'Book'^000000. So, would you like to disassemble the items?

scripts.translation: 如果用來製作“矯正姿勢之帽”的書和弓箭手蘋果經過精煉，製作完成後，精煉效果和鑲嵌的卡片都會消失。 ^FF0000^FF0000^000000^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: So would you like to create the Model Training Hat right now?
scripts.translation: 那麼，您現在要製作矯正姿勢之帽嗎？

scripts.text: Let me create one for you right away. Please have a seat and make yourself comfortable.
scripts.translation: 。我這就為您製作一頂。請坐，請隨意。

scripts.text: Usually we have a zeny service charge, but since you've got ^3355FFthe look^000000, I'll waive it.
scripts.translation: 通常我們會收取Zeny服務費，不過既然您很有模特氣質，費用就免了。 ^3355FF^000000

scripts.text: Please wait a moment while I put this together.
scripts.translation: 請稍等，讓我把它組裝起來。

scripts.text: That wasn't too difficult. I hope you wear this hat everyday to improve your posture.
scripts.translation: 這並不難。希望您每天都戴著它，改善姿勢。

scripts.text: You may have trouble at first, keeping your balance and trying not to drop the apple. You may even feel incredible neck pain. But for the sake of beauty, it'll all be worth it.
scripts.translation: 起初您可能會感到難以保持平衡，或者擔心蘋果掉下來。您甚至可能會感到頸部劇烈疼痛。但為了美麗，這一切都是值得的。

scripts.text: Oh, right, this arrow from the Apple of Archer is left over, so you can go ahead and take that.
scripts.translation: 哦，對了，這支箭是從弓箭手蘋果上取下後剩下的，您也拿走吧。

scripts.text: Also, I can disassemble the Model Training Hat into its original materials. So if you want the original items back, bring the Model Training Hat and the arrow I gave you.
scripts.translation: 另外，我可以把矯正姿勢之帽拆回原來的材料。如果您想取回那些物品，請帶上帽子和我給您的箭。

scripts.text: I see. You must have brought items with cards or upgrades that you didn't want to lose. Feel free to come back anytime when you are ready.

scripts.translation: ！至少我們可以幫您改善姿勢，讓您走出優雅端莊的步伐。

scripts.translation: 雖然現在無法開課，但我可以為您製作一頂特殊的“矯正姿勢之帽”。這樣，您就能獨自練習在T臺上優雅地走秀。

scripts.text: But since our director is gone, we can't really use our budget to give you a hat. If you want, please bring me the following items...

scripts.text: Then I can fashion a 'Model Training Hat' for you right away.

scripts.text: I like folding paper and making origami. I made my mommy a big paper boat, and she gave me a big smile and patted my head!

scripts.translation: .？真奇怪，我以為你現在應該已經拿到那個整人面具和那些指標了...

scripts.text: Not everyone is fortunate to have a magnificent, flawless physique. There are people in this world that have tragically lost appendages in accidents.
scripts.translation: ...不是人人都能有幸擁有這麼完美的體魄。這世上，也有人不幸在意外中失去了肢體。

scripts.text: When I realized this, I decided to help these people and began to research technology for artificial limbs. My studies have lead me to Alarms and their own mechanical limbs known as 'Ruimento.'
scripts.translation: 想到這些，我就決定幫助他們，開始研究假肢技術。後來，我注意到鍾怪和它們那種名為“魯伊門托”的機械肢體。

scripts.text: The Alarms, and their 'Ruimento,' are made from an ancient mysterious technology. You can only find these in the Clock Tower.
scripts.translation: 鍾怪和它們的“魯伊門托”都來自一種古老而神秘的技術。只有在鐘樓才能找到它們。

scripts.text: So I am trying to research a method to reproduce Ruimetto, except in a smaller form for the human body. If I'm successful, it would be a medical miracle!
scripts.translation: 所以我正在研究如何重新制造這種機械肢體，只是要做得更小，好讓人類也能使用。要是成功，那將是醫學奇蹟！

scripts.text: However, I need help in completing my research. Hence, the reason I've told you my story, adventurer.
scripts.translation: 然而，我需要幫助來完成我的研究。這就是我向你講述我故事的原因，冒險者。

scripts.text: I desperately need materials to continuing testing so that I can develop a prototype. I'll need ^0000FFClock Hand^000000 from Alarms and ^0000FFMr. Scream^000000 in order to continue my research.
scripts.translation: 我急需材料繼續測試、開發原型。我需要鍾怪身上的指標和整人面具才能繼續研究。 ^0000FF^000000^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: I would collect these things myself but everytime I go up to the Clock Tower, I can't bear to break the Alarms, and just stare in awe at their mechanical, masculine physiques.
scripts.translation: 本來想自己去收集，可一上鐘樓，就捨不得拆毀鍾怪。只能對著它們機械般健美的身材，驚歎不已。

scripts.text: If you help me out, I promise to give you, um...
scripts.translation: ...如果你能幫我的忙，我保證會給你，呃...

scripts.text: I'd wear it myself, if it weren't for the fact that people never look at my face anyway. Everyone I meet seems to be fixated on my chiseled form. But trust me, this mask is pretty cool.
scripts.translation: 如果不是因為人們從來不看我的臉，我肯定會自己戴上的。我遇到的每個人似乎都只盯著我雕刻般的身材。但相信我，這個面具真的很酷。

scripts.text: Help me give muscles to the world.
Oh~~! You know how I feel about Alarm's beautiful mechanic muscle! I am glad to have met someone who shares my good sense of taste.
scripts.translation: 哦~~！你也懂得欣賞鍾怪那美麗的機械肌肉！很高興能遇到和我品味相投的人。

scripts.text: With those, I will be able to continue my research, at least for a while. As I told you, I will give you this awesome ^0000FFAlarm Mask^000000 for those items!
scripts.translation: 有了這些，我就能繼續研究一陣子。正如我說的，只要給我這些東西，這個超棒的^0000FF鍾怪面具^000000就歸你了！

scripts.text: Let's spread our love for muscle around the globe!
scripts.translation: ！讓我們把對肌肉的熱愛傳遍全球！

scripts.text: I guess I must have pumped one of these glorious biceps on accident.
scripts.translation: ！！我大概是不小心繃起了一塊光彩奪目的二頭肌。

scripts.text: I forget how breathtaking the sheer majesty of my body can be. It's alright, take your time, savor the visual pleasure...
scripts.translation: 我都忘了自己的體魄有多麼令人屏息。沒關係，慢慢來，盡情享受這視覺盛宴...
不過聽好，研究要繼續，需

scripts.text: in order to continue my research.
As I told you, I will give you this really nifty ^0000FFAlarm Mask^000000 for those items, as well as do any sort of pose for you.
scripts.translation: 答應你的，這個超酷的鐘怪假面歸你。想看什麼姿勢，我也擺給你看。 ^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: Let's spread our love for muscle around the globe!
scripts.translation: ！讓我們把對肌肉的熱愛傳遍全球！

scripts.text: - to receive more items from this NPC. -
- you put some items into Kafra Storage. -
scripts.translation: 存進卡普拉倉庫，再來試試。 -

scripts.text: Ah, a Claw of Desert Wolf~!
You can only get one of those if you've been traveling for a long time in the desert. I guess someone like you also appreciates the beauty of my homeland.
scripts.translation: 只有在沙漠裡旅行很久的人才能拿到這個。看來像你這樣的人也欣賞我家鄉的美麗。

scripts.text: If you've spent enough time in the Morocc desert, I'm sure you also appreciate the value of a high quality hat to beat the heat.
scripts.translation: 哈~在夢羅克沙漠待久了，就知道一頂遮陽好帽子有多重要。

scripts.text: Tell you what. I've learned a lot studying about animals, so if you give me the right materials, I'll make you a ^3355FFtruly great hat^000000.
scripts.translation: 這樣吧。我研究動物學到了很多，所以如果你給我合適的材料，我會為你製作一頂真正出色的帽子。 ^3355FF^000000

scripts.text: If you give me any equipment compounded with cards or with upgrades, ^ff0000any upgraded abilities and cards in those items will be lost after I make something out of them.^000000 So, please keep that in mind.
scripts.translation: .若拿精煉過或插過卡的裝備作材料，製成新物品後，原有的精煉效果和卡片都會消失。請務必記住。 ^ff0000^000000

scripts.text: Excellent! Okay, give me some time to create the 'Drooping Cat.'
scripts.translation: 來了。太好了！請給我一點時間，讓我製作“懶洋洋的貓帽”。

scripts.text: Those don't sound like hat-making noises...^000000
scripts.translation: 嗯...這聽起來不像是製作帽子的聲音... ^000000

scripts.text: Oh, don't worry. It's almost done.
Your own 'Drooping Cat' hat, powered by a scientific principle! Also, would you mind if I keep that Desert Wolf Claw? Heh heh, thanks~
scripts.translation: 這是專屬你的“懶洋洋的貓帽”，由科學原理驅動！另外，沙漠之狼之指甲能不能留給我？嘿嘿，謝謝~
我為什麼不給你做一頂

scripts.text: Having a cat for a hat makes a certain sort of sense if you'll just hear me out...
scripts.translation: 洋的貓帽”呢？只要聽我解釋，你就會明白用貓做帽子是有某種道理的...

scripts.text: At the Juno Library, I read in this issue of 'Funtime Kid Science' that all cats, whether they're wild or domesticated, are hunters that have mastered the art of saving their energy.
scripts.translation: 在朱諾圖書館，我在《兒童趣味科學》的一期雜誌上讀到，所有的貓，無論是野生的還是家養的，都是精通節省能量藝術的獵人。

scripts.text: After investing many hours napping in the sun, they've developed the perfect position to nap in any place and in any condition: the lazy feline droop.
scripts.translation: 在太陽底下打了無數次盹以後，它們找到了最完美的睡姿，不管什麼地方、什麼環境都能睡：貓咪那懶洋洋的垂趴姿勢。

scripts.text: It's impossible for humans to even imitate this special feline skill without the inspiration from this hat!
scripts.translation: 沒有這頂帽子的啟發，人類連模仿這種貓科動物的特殊本領都做不到！

scripts.text: And even if you don't manage to copy the napping cat droop, at least this'll keep the sun off the top of your head, if not out of your eyes.
scripts.translation: 就算學不會貓咪那懶洋洋的睡姿，至少它也能擋住頭頂的太陽，雖然未必遮得住眼睛。

scripts.text: I will make a Drooping Cat right away when you bring all of those items.
scripts.translation: 當你把所有材料都帶來後，我會立刻為你製作“懶洋洋的貓帽”。

scripts.text: Excellent! Okay, give me some time to put this 'Smokie Leaf' together.
scripts.translation: 帶來了。太好了！請給我一點時間，我來組裝這個“變身樹葉”。

scripts.text: Those don't sound like hat-making noises...^000000
scripts.translation: 嗯...這聽起來不像是製作帽子的聲音... ^000000

scripts.text: Oh, don't worry. It's almost done.
Your own 'Smokie Leaf' hat, powered by a scientific principle! Also, would you mind if I keep that Desert Wolf Claw? Heh heh, thanks~
scripts.translation: 這是你的“變身樹葉帽”，可是按科學原理製作的！哦，這個沙漠之狼之指甲就讓我留下吧？嘿嘿，謝謝~

scripts.text: I know, I know, wearing a big ol' Leaf on top of your head sounds impractical. But, it makes a certain sort of sense if you'll just hear me out.
scripts.translation: 我知道，我知道，在頭上戴一片大葉子聽起來很不實用。但如果你聽我解釋一下，這其實是有某種道理的。

scripts.text: Do you ever notice how on a hot day, you feel a lot cooler when you wear white, but you're a lot warmer when you wear black?
scripts.translation: 你有沒有注意到，在炎熱的日子裡，穿白色衣服會覺得涼快很多，而穿黑色衣服則會覺得熱很多？

scripts.text: After some intense thinking, and reading some 'Funtime Kid Science' magazines in Juno, I realized that the color black absorbs sunlight and heat, and that the color white reflects it.
scripts.translation: 在朱諾讀了幾期《兒童趣味科學》，再經過一番深入思考，我明白了：黑色會吸收陽光和熱量，白色會反射它們。

scripts.text: What happens if you're wearing no colors? If my ^333333*ahem*^000000 hypothesis is correct, you wouldn't feel any heat if you were invisible!
scripts.translation: ...沒有顏色會怎樣？要是我的*咳咳*假設成立，隱身以後，豈不就完全不熱了！ ^333333^000000

scripts.text: That's why I've created this Racoon Leaf, in an attempt to imitate Smokie's uncanny invisibility powers.
scripts.translation: 這就是我製作“變身樹葉帽”的原因，我想借此模仿狸貓不可思議的隱形能力。

scripts.text: I haven't gotten it to work the way I want to yet. But it's a big leaf! It'll offer some shade.
scripts.translation: ..我還沒能讓它完全按我想要的樣子工作。但它是一片大葉子！它能提供一些陰涼。

scripts.text: All I need to make this is...
It's weird, but I need a whole lot of little leaves to make a big one.
scripts.translation: 00000。說來也怪，做一片大葉子，反而得用上很多小葉子。

scripts.text: Excellent! Okay, give me some time to create the 'Lazy Smokie' hat.
scripts.translation: 好了！請給我一點時間，做一頂“懶洋洋的狸貓帽帽”.

scripts.text: Those don't sound like hat-making noises...^000000
scripts.translation: 嗯...這聽起來不像是製作帽子的聲音... ^000000

scripts.text: Oh, don't worry. It's almost done.
Your own 'Lazy Smokie' hat, powered by a scientific principle! Also, would you mind if I keep that Desert Wolf Claw? Heh heh, thanks~
scripts.translation: 是你的“懶洋洋的狸貓帽帽”，可是按科學原理製作的！哦，這個沙漠之狼之指甲就讓我留下吧？嘿嘿，謝謝~

scripts.text: I know, I know, having a Racoon on your head sounds ridiculous, but it makes a certain sort of sense if you'll just hear me out.
scripts.translation: 我知道，我知道，頭上頂著一隻狸貓聽起來很荒謬，但如果你聽我解釋一下，這其實是有某種道理的。

scripts.text: So I learned from an issue of 'Funtime Kid Science' at Juno Library that different colors absorb or reflect sunlight.
scripts.translation: 所以我在朱諾圖書館的一本《兒童趣味科學》雜誌上了解到，不同的顏色會吸收或反射陽光。

scripts.text: Wearing one color makes you feel warmer, and another makes you feel cooler on a hot day.
scripts.translation: 在炎熱的日子裡，穿一種顏色會讓你感覺更熱，而另一種顏色會讓你感覺更涼快。

scripts.text: What if I had no colors?
scripts.translation: 如果我沒有任何顏色呢？

scripts.text: And, as we all know, you wear no colors if you're invisible, or when you're completely nude. I've already conducted my nudity experiment with sad and pitiable results...
scripts.translation: 大家都知道，隱形了，或者脫光了，就沒有顏色。裸體實驗我已經做過，結局真是悲慘...

scripts.text: So now I'm experimenting with invisibility. I've tried using a human sized Smokie Leaf to become invisible, but it didn't really work yet. So I got to thinking...
scripts.translation: 所以我現在正在研究隱形。我試過用一張人類尺寸的變身樹葉來讓自己隱形，但效果並不理想。於是我開始思考...

scripts.text: If I somehow connected a Smokie to me, would I become invisible when he becomes invisible?
scripts.translation: 如果我把一隻狸貓和我連線起來，當它隱形時，我是不是也會隱形？

scripts.text: I haven't been able to try it yet, because Smokies are pretty heavy and I've got to build up my neck muscles before I can strap a Smokie to my head.
scripts.translation: 我還沒法嘗試，因為狸貓挺重的，我得先鍛鍊頸部肌肉，才能把狸貓綁在頭上。

scripts.text: So of course I need a practice Smokie to wear on my head before I'm ready for the real thing.
scripts.translation: 所以，在準備好真正的狸貓之前，我當然需要一隻練習用的狸貓戴在頭上。

scripts.text: And that was how I invented the 'Lazy Smokie' hat.
scripts.translation: 就這樣，我發明了“懶洋洋的狸貓帽”帽子。

scripts.text: Excellent! Okay, give me some time to create the 'Blue Fish' hat out of all this fish.
scripts.translation: 了。太好了！請給我一點時間，用這些魚製作“藍色魚”帽子。

scripts.text: Those don't sound like hat-making noises...^000000
scripts.translation: 嗯...這聽起來不像是製作帽子的聲音... ^000000

scripts.text: Oh, don't worry. It's almost done.
Your own 'Blue Fish' hat, powered by a scientific principle! Also, would you mind if I keep that Desert Wolf Claw? Heh heh, thanks~
scripts.translation: 你的藍色魚帽子，可是按科學原理做出來的！哦，這個沙漠之狼之指甲，就讓我留下吧？嘿嘿，謝謝~

scripts.text: I know putting a Fish on top of your head doesn't sound like the best idea, but it makes a certain sort of sense if you'll just hear me out.
scripts.translation: 我知道，頭上頂著一隻魚聽起來不是個好主意，但如果你聽我解釋一下，這其實是有某種道理的。

scripts.text: So I was reading some issues of 'Funtime Kid Science' at the Juno Library, and read about animals that take naps under the sun when they feel really hot.
scripts.translation: 所以我在朱諾圖書館讀了幾期《兒童趣味科學》雜誌，瞭解到有些動物在感覺特別熱的時候會在陽光下打盹。

scripts.text: Animals that don't take naps under the sun must never feel hot?
scripts.translation: 那些不在陽光下打盹的動物，一定從不覺得熱吧？

scripts.text: I decided to make a hat of that one perfect beast that was immune to the sun, never having to succumb its power.
scripts.translation: 我決定找一種完全不怕太陽、從不向烈日屈服的完美動物，做成帽子。

scripts.text: I set to work immediately, listing all the animals I know that don't take naps in the sun. Then, I removed any animals from the list that I didn't like, especially the ones with really long names.
scripts.translation: 我立刻開始工作，列出了所有我知道的不在陽光下打盹的動物。然後，我把我不喜歡的動物從列表中刪掉了，尤其是那些名字特別長的。

scripts.text: Finally, I had only three creatures on my list: the Emu, the Giraffe and the Fish.
scripts.translation: 最後，我的列表上只剩下三種生物：鴯鶓、長頸鹿和魚。

scripts.text: First, I removed Emu, because everyone kept telling me I was spelling it wrong. And as everyone knows, a Giraffe hat would just look ridiculous. So, of course, I chose the Fish.
scripts.translation: 首先，我刪掉了鴯鶓，因為大家一直說我拼寫錯了。而且眾所周知，長頸鹿帽子看起來會很荒謬。所以，我當然選擇了魚。

scripts.text: And that, my friend, was how I invented the 'Blue Fish' hat.
scripts.translation: 就這樣，我的朋友，我發明了“藍色魚”帽子。

scripts.text: I'm a little disappointed, but you probably already have a nice hat to keep the sun out of your eyes. Well, if you change your mind, I'll be here.
scripts.translation: 我明白了。我有點失望，但你大概已經有一頂不錯的帽子來遮擋陽光了。好吧，如果你改變主意，我會在這裡。

scripts.text: I live here, I should know. Still, nothing can beat the Morocc sunset.
scripts.translation: 。我住在這裡，我當然知道。不過，沒有什麼能比得上夢羅克的日落。

scripts.text: It's amazing how so many different animals can live in the desert. I've been spending some time researching the ways of animals, reading books in the Juno Library...
scripts.translation: 真令人驚歎，沙漠裡竟然能生存這麼多不同的動物。我花了一些時間研究動物的習性，在朱諾圖書館裡讀了不少書...

scripts.text: Trying to figure out the Animal Kingdom's secrets of dealing with the heat.
scripts.translation: 試圖弄清楚動物王國應對高溫的秘密。

scripts.text: I hope you're having a good time here in Morocc. If you ever question the special abilities of animals, just think of the majestic Desert Wolf that's able to thrive in the harsh Morocc deserts.
scripts.translation: 我希望你在夢羅克玩得開心。如果你懷疑動物的特殊能力，想想那隻在嚴酷的夢羅克沙漠中繁衍生息的雄偉沙漠之狼吧。

scripts.text: - you put some items into Kafra Storage. -
scripts.translation: 存入卡普拉倉庫，再回來。 -

scripts.text: Oh! You finally brought what I've asked, human. Okay, now I can bring her back to life!
scripts.translation: 哦！你終於帶來了我要的東西，人類。好了，現在我可以讓她復活了！

scripts.text: Now why am I in human form again?
I guess... I need to practice transformation more often. *Sigh*
scripts.translation: 我想...我需要更經常練習變身。*嘆氣*

scripts.text: Anyway, I've got a bone to pick with you humans. You're an aggressive and greedy race, always killing things and taking stuff. And despite all the hunting, you never seem to be satisfied.
scripts.translation: 總之，我有一筆賬要和你們人類算。你們是個好鬥且貪婪的種族，總是殺戮並奪取東西。儘管獵殺了這麼多，你們似乎永遠都不滿足。

scripts.text: You always intrude our territory to slay us foxes for our nice, soft fur. But it's not only us you harass. The Sohees always complain that you barbaric humans keep stealing their clothing!
scripts.translation: 你們總是侵入我們的領地，獵殺我們狐狸以獲取我們柔軟漂亮的皮毛。但你們騷擾的不僅僅是我們。鬼女們總是抱怨你們這些野蠻的人類不斷偷竊她們的衣服！

scripts.text: My wife was killed as a victim of human greed, probably skinned for her fabulous pelt...
scripts.translation: 我的妻子死於人類的貪婪，大概就是為了她那身漂亮的皮毛，被剝了皮...

scripts.text: All I want is to bring her back to life, no matter what the cost. That's why I'm swallowing my pride and asking you for help.
scripts.translation: 我只想讓她復活，不惜一切代價。這就是我放下尊嚴，向你求助的原因。

scripts.text: in order to cast the Fox Resurrection spell.
I know how you humans think...
scripts.translation: 我知道你們人類是怎麼想

scripts.text: You want some sort of reward for whatever mayhem you cause. Alright then...
scripts.translation: 的...你們總是想為造成的破壞索取某種報酬。好吧...

scripts.text: I will give you this ^0000FFKitsune Mask^000000 if you bring me what I asked. How does that sound? Remember, ^0000FF999 ^FF0000Nine Tail^000000.
scripts.translation: 帶來我要的東西，就把這個狐狸假面給你。怎麼樣？記住，999條狐狸尾巴。 ^0000FF^000000^0000FF^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: Human, what are you doing in my home?!
I guess you decided to come inside, thinking no one was around, to rest after killing others of my kind.
scripts.translation: 殺完我的同類，以為裡面沒人，就進來歇腳了，是吧。

scripts.text: Well! We Orcs are a proud race!
scripts.translation: 聽著！我們獸人是驕傲的種

scripts.text: So don't expect me to talk to you.
scripts.translation: 族！所以別指望我會跟你

scripts.text: Though, I must admit that you have courage to enter an Orc's home.
scripts.translation: 說話。不過，我不得不承認，你有勇氣進入獸人的家。

scripts.text: I'm too tired to kill you today, but keep silent! If you're wounded, you can bleed quietly on the floor and die with some honor I suppose.
scripts.translation: 今天太累，懶得殺你，不過給我安靜點！受了傷，就默默在地板上流血吧，死也算死得有點尊嚴。

scripts.text: You dare invite an Orc to conversation?! We Orcs are a savage race! Born out suffering, we only live to fight and do battle!
scripts.translation: 你竟敢邀請一個獸人交談？！我們獸人是野蠻的種族！在苦難中出生，我們只為戰鬥和廝殺而活！

scripts.text: Hah! The only way I will suffer such humiliation would be if you too, lost your dignity.
scripts.translation: ？！哈！要我受這份屈辱，除非你也肯丟掉自己的尊嚴。

scripts.text: You can bleed in my house, but I will only talk with you if...
scripts.translation: 你可以繼續在我家流血。不過，想讓我開口，除非...帶來

scripts.text: I challenge you to a duel, Orc!

scripts.translation: 人類...真是一群討厭的傢伙

scripts.text: If you want to fight, go outside!
So get out of my house!
Are all you humans so foolish?!

scripts.translation: 那可是好多傑勒比結晶啊！！

scripts.text: I do not like this joke you have played on me human. Still, I refuse to believe that you have really brought ^FF00001000 Jellopy^000000.
scripts.translation: 我不喜歡你對我開的這個玩笑，人類。不過，我拒絕相信你真的帶來了1000個傑勒比結晶。 ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: We Orcs are a proud race and do not like to admit when we are wrong.
scripts.translation: 我們獸人是驕傲的種族，不喜歡承認自己錯了。

scripts.text: I hate humans! In fact, all Orcs hate humans! Hate you hate you hate you with a passion!
scripts.translation: 我恨人類！所有獸人都恨人類！恨你，恨你，恨死你了！

scripts.text: Still in the mood to talk?!
Now get out of here, you horrible stinking, poor excuse for an animal!!
scripts.translation: 現在滾出這裡，你這臭烘烘、低劣的畜生！！

scripts.text: What are you doing with so much Jellopy?!
scripts.translation: 你帶著這麼多傑勒比結晶，到底想幹什麼？！

scripts.text: I refuse to speak to you until I've finished counting all of this Jellopy.
scripts.translation: ..在我數完這些傑勒比結晶之前，我拒絕和你說話。

scripts.text: Once again, human, you've managed to infuriate me. But we Orcs are a proud race. I shall fulfill my part of this pathetic deal.
scripts.translation: 人類，你又一次成功激怒了我。但我們獸人是驕傲的種族。我會履行這份可笑協議中的義務。

scripts.text: Humans are always invading our village, intruding on our land! They kill our warriors not out of honor, but for selfish human reasons!!
scripts.translation: 人類總是入侵我們的村莊，踐踏我們的土地！他們殺害我們的戰士，不是為了榮譽，而是為了人類自私的理由！！

scripts.text: Bah! Humans have built their own towns and cities. Do they keep their senseless killing amongst each other?! NO! Humans have to rampage and ravage everything!!
scripts.translation: 哼，人類有自己的城鎮。可他們會只在自己人之間，無謂地廝殺嗎？！不會！偏要到處橫行，毀掉一切！！

scripts.text: I do not think that you can endure much more of this torture.
scripts.translation: 傑勒比結晶！這種折騰，你還能撐得住多久呢？哇
說話，就表現出你的尊重。

scripts.text: Again, human, you confound me with your stubborness. I see that humans are masochists. Or just like to annoy Orcs by making them count a thousand Jellopies.
scripts.translation: .人類，你這股倔勁兒，真讓人想不通。莫非你們都是受虐狂，還是就愛逼獸人數一千個傑勒比結晶，故意氣人？

scripts.text: Oh right, why humans are scum.
scripts.translation: 哦，對，人類為什麼是人渣。

scripts.text: How dare humans think they're so great?! We Orcs have also made contributions to the world!
scripts.translation: 人類怎麼敢覺得自己那麼偉大？！我們獸人也對世界做出了貢獻！

scripts.text: Humans may have built cities and towns, but we Orcs have also created our own cave complexes and canals!
scripts.translation: 人類也許建立了城市，但我們獸人也創造了我們自己的洞穴群和運河！

scripts.text: We Orcs have invented many useful things! Of course, now we've had to keep these things to ourselves. Why? Because of the stupidity and greed of humans!!
scripts.translation: 我們獸人發明了許多有用的東西！當然，現在我們不得不把這些東西藏起來。為什麼？因為人類的愚蠢和貪婪！！

scripts.text: We Orcs have once constructed a tower for a human, but were then trapped and enslaved there. Needless to say, humans are deserving of our wrath and fury.
scripts.translation: 我們獸人曾替一個人類修建高塔，最後卻被困在塔裡，淪為奴隸。你說，人類是不是活該承受我們的怒火。

scripts.text: I don't understand why I am sharing this story about my tribe.
scripts.translation: 氣*我不明白我為什麼要分享關於我部落的故事。

scripts.text: Grrr~! If you want to listen longer go bring me ^FF00001000 Jellopy^000000 again.
scripts.translation: 怒吼~！還想聽，就再帶1,000個傑勒比結晶來。 ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: I don't take the 2,000 jellopies you have given to me seriously!!
scripts.translation: 拿出誠意！！之前那2,000個，我可沒放在眼裡！！

scripts.text: I can see the Jellopy in your hands, and I'm pretty sure you've brought a thousand again, so let's get this over with.
scripts.translation: 你。看見你手裡的傑勒比結晶了，肯定又是一千個。那就趕快說完吧。

scripts.text: *Sigh* I suppose it's time for our conversation.
scripts.translation: *嘆氣* 我想，是時候開始我們的對話了。

scripts.text: Once upon a time, Orcs and humans were allies. I... I miss those times. But it's no use to long for old comraderies. It's impossible to clear up such misunderstandings from ages ago...
scripts.translation: 很久以前，獸人與人類曾是盟友。我...也懷念那段日子。可懷念舊日情誼，終究沒用。積下了那麼久的誤會，哪還能解得開...

scripts.text: There are too many wicked humans that have pursued wealth and fame at any cost. They don't understand ideals like honor and loyalty, and use any means to get whatever they want.
scripts.translation: 有太多邪惡的人類，為了財富和名聲不擇手段。他們不懂榮譽和忠誠這樣的理想，為了得到想要的東西，什麼手段都使得出來。

scripts.text: Those hateful humans started to get rid of every obstacle that stood between them and what they wanted, not caring if friend or foe stood in their way.
scripts.translation: 那些令人憎恨的人類開始清除擋在他們和慾望之間的一切障礙，無論是朋友還是敵人，只要擋路就毫不留情。

scripts.text: That's the end of the conversation for today.
Now, if you want to listen some more, go bring me
scripts.translation: 現在，如果你想繼續聽，明天再給我帶

scripts.text: I don't take the 3,000 jellopies you have given to me seriously.
scripts.translation: 就拿出誠意。之前那3,000個，我可沒放在眼裡。

scripts.text: You're too tough to get rid of.
Do you really want to listen to me so much...?
scripts.translation: 你真的這麼想聽我說話嗎...

scripts.text: Okay... I will tell you a little bit more then.
For us Orcs, victory in battle is the greatest honor.
scripts.translation: 獸人最大的榮譽，就是在戰鬥中取勝

scripts.text: We fight boldly and fearlessly with our opponent, giving our all in hopes of a fair victory. We would die for victory in battle.
scripts.translation: 。我們勇敢無畏，傾盡全力，只求光明正大地擊敗對手。為此，連性命也可以捨棄。

scripts.text: Even after death, we never lose the spirit of combat. It is said that some Orcs that have died unfairly will stand from their graves to seek even more battle.
scripts.translation: 就算死去，戰意也不會消散。據說，有些獸人死得不明不白，便會從墳墓裡爬起來，再戰一場。

scripts.text: The difference between you humans and us is that we would never tolerate foul play in battle. But more importantly, Orcs never, ever retreat. An Orc will always fight till the last breath...
scripts.translation: 你們人類和我們的區別在於，我們絕不容忍戰鬥中的卑鄙手段。但更重要的是，獸人絕不撤退。獸人會戰鬥到最後一口氣...

scripts.text: Orcs never restore health during battle using your silly medicines. Hmpf. Humans can be so weak, drinking bottles of Potion to keep up in a fight. Oh well, though, I'm not sure if you're the same.
scripts.translation: 獸人從不在戰鬥中用你們那些愚蠢的藥水來恢復體力。哼。人類真脆弱，為了在戰鬥中撐下去，還得喝一瓶瓶的藥水。不過，我也不確定你是不是也一樣。

scripts.text: I don't take the 4,000 jellopies you have given to me seriously.
scripts.translation: 就拿出誠意。之前那4,000個，我可沒放在眼裡。

scripts.text: What the...! Don't you know when to stop? I do not believe a human would like to hear about Orcs so much. But...
scripts.translation: 該死的...！你不知道適可而止嗎？我不相信會有人類這麼想聽關於獸人的事。但是...我們獸人

scripts.text: We Orcs are a proud race, and I shall oblige.
scripts.translation: 是一個驕傲的種族，我會滿足你的要求。

scripts.text: We only select the strongest of our tribe to become warriors. When Orcs reach adulthood, they are sent to the forest to survive alone in its environment.
scripts.translation: 我們只挑選部落中最強壯的個體成為戰士。當獸人成年後，它們會被送入森林，獨自在那裡生存。

scripts.text: Those Orcs that come back alive are recognized as true members of the tribe. The strongest males are chosen to become Orc Warriors, and the strongest females are chosen as Orc Ladies.
scripts.translation: 活著歸來的獸人，才算部落真正的一員。最強的男性成為獸人戰士，最強的女性則成為獸人女戰士。

scripts.text: Orcs that have proven to have good sight and dexterity are given bows and arrows and become Orc Archers.
scripts.translation: 那些被證明擁有良好視力和敏捷性的獸人，會被授予弓箭，成為獸人弓箭手。

scripts.text: We Orcs have a special training course called 'The Trial of Fire.' If any Orc Warrior passes this course, he will be protected by our fire god...
scripts.translation: 我們獸人有一項特殊的訓練課程，叫做“火之試煉”。如果任何獸人戰士通過了這項課程，他將受到我們火神的庇護...

scripts.text: That Orc will have stronger physical strength and abilities than normal Orc Warriors. These warriors are known as High Orcs.
scripts.translation: 他們的力量和本領，都會強過普通獸人戰士。這些戰士被稱為高等獸人。

scripts.text: Hm, well to you humans, we may all look the same, but we Orcs can tell each other apart. How about you, human? Do I look the same as every Warrior outside to you?
scripts.translation: 嗯，在你們人類眼裡，我們可能都長得差不多，但我們獸人之間能互相分辨。那麼你呢，人類？在你眼裡，我和外面的每個戰士看起來都一樣嗎？

scripts.text: I don't take the 5,000 jellopies you have given to me seriously.
scripts.translation: 意。之前那5,000個，我可沒放在眼裡。

scripts.text: I expected you to quit by now. But I was wrong, because you're here once again. We made a deal and I will keep my promise.
scripts.translation: 我以為你早就放棄了。但我錯了，因為你又來了。我們既然達成了約定，我就會信守承諾。

scripts.text: Sometimes, a few Orcs are born among us, possessing phenomenal strength and talent. It is rumored that they could compete with 10,000 warriors at a time...
scripts.translation: 有時候，我們中間會誕生一些擁有非凡力量和天賦的獸人。據說他們能同時對抗一萬名戰士...

scripts.text: They are the best warriors of the Orc tribe, and are known to you as Orc Heroes. Not only are they the strongest ones among us, but they also our leaders in battle.
scripts.translation: 他們是獸人部落中最優秀的戰士，也就是你們所說的獸人英雄。他們不僅是我們當中最強的，也是戰場上的領袖。

scripts.text: As proof of their status, Orc Heroes are given Vouchers of Orcish Hero, as well as special swords that are only allowed to be used by our heroes.
scripts.translation: 作為地位的象徵，獸人英雄會被授予獸人英雄之證，以及只有我們英雄才能使用的特別的劍。

scripts.text: That sword can tear the sky, sever the earth and make a waterfall flow backwards.
scripts.translation: 那把劍能撕裂天空，斬斷大地，甚至能讓瀑布倒流。

scripts.text: The special helmet that is only worn by Orc Heroes represents the power and honor of the Orc Warriors.
scripts.translation: 只有獸人英雄才能佩戴的特殊頭盔，象徵著獸人戰士的力量與榮耀。

scripts.text: Well, humans rarely get the chance to see this helmet unless they're in battle with an Orc Hero themselves...
scripts.translation: 嗯，人類很少有機會看到這頂頭盔，除非他們親自與獸人英雄交戰...

scripts.text: I don't take the 6,000 jellopies you have given to me that seriously.
scripts.translation: 我可沒把你給我的那6000個傑勒比結晶當回事。

scripts.text: Go ahead and put the 1000 Jellopies over there on the table by the skulls.
scripts.translation: 。把那1000個傑勒比結晶放到那邊骷髏旁邊的桌子上吧。

scripts.text: Ah yes, we were talking about Orc Heroes. Now, unlike Orc Heroes who are blessed with might from the day they were born, there are older, seasoned warriors that have managed to survive many years of combat.
scripts.translation: 對，先前說到了獸人英雄。他們生來就力量非凡，另有一些年長的戰士，卻是憑本事熬過多年征戰，積累了豐富的經驗。

scripts.text: To Orc Warriors, we do not see age as weakness. We look up to old warriors as our trainers due to their experience in battle and their fighting skills.
scripts.translation: 獸人戰士不會把年老看成軟弱。老戰士戰鬥經驗豐富，武藝精湛，我們都尊他們為師。

scripts.text: Those old warriors have shown outstanding fighting abilities, even without the use of weapons.
scripts.translation: 這些老戰士展現了卓越的戰鬥力，即使不使用武器也是如此。

scripts.text: They could endure in battle for at least few days without axes. When you get to a certain fighting skill level, weapons can actually become a burden...
scripts.translation: 他們能在沒有戰斧的情況下，在戰鬥中堅持好幾天。當武藝達到一定境界時，武器反而會成為負擔...

scripts.text: Among those well-experienced warriors, the greatest one of all is given the title of Orc Lord, and is given our respect as the leader of our tribe.
scripts.translation: 在這些經驗豐富的戰士中，最偉大的一位會被授予獸人酋長的頭銜，並受到我們作為部落首領的尊敬。

scripts.text: Every Orc can recognize him by his distinguished helm with the three horns.
scripts.translation: 每個獸人都能通過他頭上那頂長著三隻角的獨特頭盔認出他。

scripts.text: I don't take the 7,000 jellopies you have given to me seriously.
scripts.translation: 意。之前那7,000個，我可沒放在眼裡。

scripts.text: It's been a while I've seen such a determined human such as yourself. Just leave the Jellopy near the bed.
scripts.translation: 好久沒見過像你這樣意志堅定的人類了。把傑勒比結晶放在床邊就好。

scripts.text: Although I don't like to admit it, there are cowardly Orcs that run away from battle, or fight using dishonorable methods.
scripts.translation: 雖然我不願承認，但確實有一些懦弱的獸人，他們會在戰鬥中逃跑，或者使用卑鄙的手

scripts.text: Needless to say, they have brought shame and disgrace to our tribe.
scripts.translation: 段。不用說，他們給部落帶來了恥辱和汙名。

scripts.text: A curse is placed on those dishonorable Orcs so that they can be singled out by the tribe and banished from the village.
scripts.translation: 那些不光彩的獸人會被施加詛咒，以便被部落識別出來，並驅逐出村莊。

scripts.text: You may recognize those cursed Orcs by their shrunken bodies and long teeth.
scripts.translation: 你可以通過他們萎縮的身體和長長的牙齒認出那些被詛咒的獸人。

scripts.text: We call these cursed Orcs Zenorc. They are forced to live inside of caves or dungeons, away from from honorable Orcs. It's difficult to believe that Zenorcs were once one of us...
scripts.translation: 受詛咒的獸人，我們叫他們茲諾克。他們只能住在洞穴或地下城里，遠離有榮譽的族人。真難相信，他們也曾是我們的一員...

scripts.text: I don't think there is a curse which transforms humans into a totally ugly creature depending on their deeds. So it is difficult to tell which humans are honorable...
scripts.translation: 我不認為存在一種詛咒，會根據人類的行為將他們變成醜陋的生物。所以很難分辨哪些人類是光榮的...

scripts.text: I don't take the 8,000 jellopies you have given to me seriously.
scripts.translation: 意。之前那8,000個，我可沒放在眼裡。

scripts.text: You have brought me 10,000 Jellopies. I must say that I am impressed. Since you have shown me your respect, I will repay you with my honesty.
scripts.translation: ，你已經送來一萬個傑勒比結晶。真讓我佩服。你給了我尊重，我也會真誠相待。

scripts.text: Considering the stories about my tribe, it's enough for me if you just listen. However, merely listening is totally different from having the experience as your own.
scripts.translation: 關於部落的故事，你肯聽，我就很滿足。不過，耳聽和親身經歷，終究是兩回事。

scripts.text: I suggest you that you experience more battles with the many different Orcs out there. That's the best way of understanding and learning about the Orc tribe.
scripts.translation: 我建議你多去和外面各種各樣的獸人戰鬥。這是瞭解和認識獸人部落的最好方式。

scripts.text: This is a small token of my gratitue. This axe used to aid me in many battles and is very precious to me. I hope you will take care of this.
scripts.translation: 這把斧頭，算是我的一點謝意。它曾陪我征戰多次，對我十分珍貴。好好愛惜它。

scripts.text: You have made a lot of effort to show me respect, despite being a human. Now, if you want to learn more about Orcs, feel free to come back anytime, my friend.
scripts.translation: 作為一個人類，你付出了很多努力來向我表示敬意。現在，如果你想了解更多關於獸人的事，隨時歡迎回來，我的朋友。

scripts.text: I don't take 9,000 jellopies you have given to me seriously.
scripts.translation: 拿出誠意。之前那9,000個，我可沒放在眼裡。

scripts.text: You have made a lot of effort to show me your respect. Now, if you want to learn more about Orcs, feel free to come back anytime, my friend.
scripts.translation: 你付出了很多努力來向我表示敬意。現在，如果你想了解更多關於獸人的事，隨時歡迎回來，我的朋友。

scripts.text: Oh, I see you've taken my advice and have been meeting many other Orcs through battle.
scripts.translation: 哦，看來你聽從了我的建議，通過戰鬥結識了許多其他獸人

scripts.text: You must have learned much about the Orc's spirit of battle by seeing it for yourself firsthand.
scripts.translation: 。親眼見證這一切，你一定對獸人的戰鬥精神有了深刻的瞭解。

scripts.text: These Orchish Vouchers you have been collecting are the true token of Orc warriors. We recognize an Orc who won over 1,000 battles as a true Orc Warrior.
scripts.translation: 你收集的這些獸人戰士之證，才是獸人戰士真正的憑證。贏下一千場戰鬥的獸人，才有資格被稱為真正的獸人戰士。

scripts.text: You're a human, so I don't give we can give you that honor so easily...
scripts.translation: ..你畢竟是人類，我不能輕易授予你這份榮譽...

scripts.text: Then, I'm sure you can be granted status as a real Orc warrior. But, make sure you are fighting for honorable purposes, and that you have no other motive.
scripts.translation: 那樣，你就能獲得真正的獸人戰士身份。不過，一定要為榮譽而戰，不能另有所圖。

scripts.text: You only achieve honor by winning battles. Even among Orcs, I'm sure you can prove your battle prowess by defeating 10,000 Orc Warriors.
scripts.translation: 只有通過贏得戰鬥才能獲得榮譽。即使是在獸人中，我相信你也能通過擊敗10000名獸人戰士來證明你的戰鬥實力。

scripts.text: I don't think that is necessary.
I see. I will not force you to choose what I wish to see you do. I respect your decision.
scripts.translation: 明白了，不勉強你照我的意思做。我尊重你的決定。

scripts.text: I wished for other Orcs to see and understand that not all humans are wicked and selfish.
scripts.translation: .我希望其他獸人能看到並理解，並非所有人類都是邪惡和自私的。

scripts.text: Ah, spoken like a true warrior. Alright then, go forth and do battle with others of my tribe, and bring me 10,000 Orcish Vouchers.
scripts.translation: 說得好，像個真正的戰士。去跟我的族人們戰鬥，帶回一萬個獸人戰士之證。

scripts.text: I took 100 Orcish Voucher from you now. Now, fight and fight until you have defeated 10,000 more Orc Warriors so that the whole tribe will have to recognize you!
scripts.translation: 我現在從你這裡拿了100個獸人戰士之證。現在，繼續戰鬥，直到你擊敗另外10000名獸人戰士，讓整個部落都承認你！

scripts.text: Hm? You don't seem to understand our way of life completely. It's strange that you are so curious about other races, human.
scripts.translation: 嗯？你似乎沒有完全理解我們的生活方式。作為一個人類，你對其他種族如此好奇，真是奇怪。

scripts.text: The best way of understanding the Orc tribe is to do battle with them. By competing in power and skills, eventually you will understand and respect your opponent.
scripts.translation: 理解獸人部落的最好方式就是與他們戰鬥。通過力量和技巧的較量，最終你會理解並尊重你的對手。

scripts.text: Although you may be learning theory by talking with me, you must experience our way of life for yourself.
scripts.translation: 。雖然你可以通過與我交談來學習理論，但你必須親自體驗我們的生活方式。

scripts.text: Hm? You don't seem to understand our way of life completely. It's strange that you are so curious about other races, human.
scripts.translation: 嗯？你似乎沒有完全理解我們的生活方式。作為一個人類，你對其他種族如此好奇，真是奇怪。

scripts.text: It doesn't seem that you've accomplished your goal yet, but I do not expect you to defeat 10,000 Orc Warriors so easily.
scripts.translation: .看起來你還沒有達成目標，但我也不指望你能輕易擊敗10000名獸人戰士。

scripts.text: If you wish, you may rest here. {0} victories over Orc Warriors are recognized by our tribe.
scripts.translation: 想休息，就留在這裡。你已贏得場對獸人戰士的勝利，部落都認可。 {0}

scripts.text: There are {0} battles ahead of you before you reach your goal. I understand the difficulty of this challenge, but I hope you make it.
scripts.translation: 離目標還差場。我知道這考驗不容易，但願你能成功。 {0}

scripts.text: For a human, accomplishing such a feat is truly astonishing. Through all of that fighting, I'm sure that you have learned both good and bad things about my tribe.
scripts.translation: 作為一個人類，能完成這樣的壯舉，真是令人驚歎。經歷了這麼多戰鬥，我相信你一定了解了我部族的許多事情，無論好壞。
現在，你就是...獸人女戰士！！

scripts.text: This is a present for you. I am not sure if it will fit to your head or not, but try it. If your head is too big to wear this, I suggest that you carry this with you.
scripts.translation: 這是送你的禮物。不知道合不合頭，先試試看。要是頭太大戴不上，就帶在身邊吧。

scripts.text: Although it doesn't look different from the others, please keep this with care. You can only be recognized as an Orc warrior with this.
scripts.translation: 雖然它看起來和其他的沒什麼不同，但請妥善保管。只有持有它，你才會被承認為獸人戰士。

scripts.text: Now, you may go back to where you have come from. Come drop by whenever my tribe comes to your mind.
scripts.translation: 現在，你可以回到你來的地方了。每當想起我的部族，歡迎隨時回來看看。

scripts.text: As you are now one who feels the true intent of the opponent after endless battles, I will now return you to the battleground.
scripts.translation: 既然你在無盡的戰鬥中，已經能夠感知對手真正的意圖，那麼我現在就送你回到戰場。

scripts.text: I see, do as you wish.
I will be really disappointed in you if you quit in a challenge you have undertaken.
scripts.translation: 便吧。如果你放棄了已經開始的挑戰，我會對你非常失望的。

scripts.text: You have won {0} victories over Orc Warriors.
Hm? You don't think you cannot come back to where you originally came, just because now you're an Orc Warrior, do you? Hahahahaha!
scripts.translation: 嗯？不會以為成了獸人戰士，就回不了原來的地方吧？哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text: Show your opponents your indomitable spirit. Take pride in being a human that has been given the title of Orc Warrior!
scripts.translation: 向你的對手展示你不屈的精神。為身為人類卻獲得獸人戰士這一稱號而感到自豪吧！

scripts.text: You don't seem to be satisfied even after being recognized as a warrior. But... I suppose the path of the warrior is to seek new and more difficult challenges.
scripts.translation: 即使被承認為戰士，你似乎也不滿足。不過...我想，戰士的道路就是不斷尋求新的、更艱難的挑戰。

scripts.text: Okay, would you like to go through another test? It may reduce all your effort in coming here to nothing. Even seasoned Orc Warriors fear taking this test.
scripts.translation: 好吧，你想再接受一次考驗嗎？這可能會讓你之前的努力付諸東流。即使是經驗豐富的獸人戰士，也畏懼接受這項考驗。

scripts.text: But, since you're an exceptional case, it might be possible for you to accomplish...
scripts.translation: 不過，既然你是特例，也許你能成功...

scripts.text: Excellent, I admire your enthusiasm. This is a very rare chance to do battle with the strongest Orc Warriors.
scripts.translation: 好，我欣賞這股熱情。能跟最強的獸人戰士交鋒，這樣的機會可不多。

scripts.text: Go fight with 100 Orc Heroes and bring me the tokens of the battles you have endured. Even if you're an excellent warrior, I assure you this test will be the hardest one you'll ever get.
scripts.translation: 去與100名獸人英雄戰鬥，並帶給我你經歷戰鬥的憑證。即使你是優秀的戰士，我向你保證，這將是你遇到的最艱難考驗。

scripts.text: Now, go, warrior! I believe that you have a chance to succeed. Fight with 100 Orc Heroes, and I will grant you, a human, recognition as an Orc Hero!
scripts.translation: 去吧，戰士！我相信你能成功。與一百名獸人英雄交戰，我就承認你這個人類也是獸人英雄！

scripts.text: Warrior, may a fresh light be with you in battle. Show your opponents your indomitable spirit. Take pride in being a human that has been given the title of Orc Warrior!
scripts.translation: 戰士，願新的光芒伴你征戰沙場。向對手展示不屈的精神。為自己身為獲授獸人戰士稱號的人類而自豪吧！

scripts.text: The Orc Heroes who were defeated by you also must have recognized your courage. Thank you, human, for showing us what is true strength.
scripts.translation: 被你擊敗的獸人英雄們，想必也認可了你的勇氣。謝謝你，人類，向我們展示了什麼是真正的力量。

scripts.text: Now, make one last choice. What would you do with those Heroic Emblems? They might not be valuable to you humans, but for Orcs, they are treasured by those who own them.
scripts.translation: 最後，再做個選擇。手裡這些獸人英雄之證，你打算怎麼處置？人類也許不覺得值錢，對獸人而言，卻是值得珍藏的寶物。

scripts.text: Since you are the victor of those battles, you have every right to keep them. But you could also return them to the Orc Heroes, meaning that you wish to meet them in battle once again.
scripts.translation: 既然你是那些戰鬥的勝利者，你完全有權保留它們。但你也可以將它們歸還給獸人英雄，這意味著你希望再次與他們戰鬥。

scripts.text: I shall return them to the Orc Heroes.
scripts.translation: 我會將它們歸還給獸人英雄

scripts.text: Nobody has the right to tell you what you can or cannot do. Please keep them as a memory of your victory.
scripts.translation: 沒有人有權告訴你什麼能做或不能做。請保留它們，作為你勝利的紀念。

scripts.text: What a great attitude for a warrior...! It will be a model to other Orcs to show respect to opponents that you have defeated!
scripts.translation: 這才是戰士應有的胸懷...！尊重被自己擊敗的對手，你給其他獸人樹立了榜樣！

scripts.text: You deserve to be an Orc Hero, the most powerful Orc warrior! As of today, you are now an Orc Hero!
scripts.translation: 你配得上成為獸人英雄，最強大的獸人戰士！從今天起，你成為了獸人英雄！

scripts.text: This is a sword only given to our heroes. I am not sure if you can use this or not, but as an Orc Hero, you're obligated to carry this with you always.
scripts.translation: 這是一把只授予我們英雄的劍。我不確定你是否能使用它，但作為獸人英雄，你有義務時刻攜帶它。

scripts.text: Although it doesn't look different from the others, I hope you will keep it with care. You can only be recognized as an Orc Hero with this token.
scripts.translation: 雖然它看起來與其他的一樣，但我希望你好好保管它。只有持有這個憑證，你才能被認可為獸人英雄。

scripts.text: A human who has a better understanding than other humans. One who showed others power regardless of the race, I leave you to the future of Chaos.
scripts.translation: 你比許多人類更懂得彼此理解，也向大家證明，力量無關種族。未來的亂世，就託付給你了。

scripts.text: Well, Orc Hero is held in high regard by other Orcs for their great power. As a human, you will probably have difficulty in dealing with him.
scripts.translation: 嗯，獸人英雄因其強大的力量而受到其他獸人的尊敬。作為人類，你大概很難對付他。

scripts.text: However, you made the decision to go through with this test! Still, there's no need to rush it. Life is an endless series of battles, so the combat will come.
scripts.translation: 不過，考驗是你自己決定接受的！也不必急於一時。人生本就是接連不斷的戰鬥，交鋒的機會總會到來。

scripts.text: Warrior, where did you leave your Heroic Emblem? Without the token, I cannot recognize you as an Orc Hero. Please find it and keep it with you anywhere you go.
scripts.translation: 戰士，你把獸人英雄之證放在哪裡了？沒有這個憑證，我無法認可你是獸人英雄。請找到它，並隨身攜帶。

scripts.text: Warrior, where did you leave your sword? Without the sword, I cannot recognize you as an Orc Hero. Please find it and keep it with you anywhere you go.
scripts.translation: 戰士，你把劍放在哪裡了？沒有這把劍，我無法認可你是獸人英雄。請找到它，並隨身攜帶。

scripts.text: May God be with you in battle!
scripts.translation: 願神在戰鬥中與你同在！

scripts.text: If you wish to challenge me, wait inside the forest at the west. I'm not in the mood to deal with humans right now.
scripts.translation: 如果你想挑戰我，去西邊的森林裡等著。我現在沒心情應付人類。

scripts.text: Hm, are you the human who was granted status as an Orc Hero?
scripts.translation: 嗯，你就是那個被授予獸人英雄身份的人類嗎？

scripts.text: I hope you know the meaning of returning my Emblem. I expect that we will meet again on the battlefield.
scripts.translation: 希望你明白，歸還我的獸人英雄之證，意味著什麼。期待在戰場上再次相遇。

scripts.text: Isn't that an Orc Warrior's Helm...?
I guess you don't know what's so special about this particular helm...
scripts.translation: 看來你不知道這頂頭盔有什麼特別之處...

scripts.text: It actually belonged to one of our Orc Lords who was defeated by a human. He was so furious about losing that he broke the middle horn and threw it away!
scripts.translation: 它其實屬於我們的一位獸人酋長，他被一個人類擊敗了。他因為戰敗而大怒，折斷了中間的角，然後把它扔掉了！

scripts.text: I was told that it somehow ended in the hands of a human, but I didn't know it was you, the human Orc Hero.
scripts.translation: 我聽說它不知怎麼落到了人類手裡，但我沒想到是你，人類獸人英雄。

scripts.text: Alright, that belongs to the Orc Lord. I mean, even though it's now yours, it was given to you by mistake.
scripts.translation: 那畢竟是獸人酋長的頭盔。雖說如今屬於你，可當初是拿錯了，才送到你手裡的。

scripts.text: Would you mind giving the item back to its owner, my human Orc Hero?
scripts.translation: 人類的獸人英雄啊，願意把它還給原主嗎？

scripts.text: Wow, you're so stubborn! Just treat the helm with care, and wear it with respect. Recognize that it has a long history...
scripts.translation: 哇，你真是固執！好好對待這頂頭盔，戴著它要心懷敬意。要知道它有著悠久的歷史...

scripts.text: Good, that's a good decision. I will give this back to him. Muhahahahaha... I didn't expect to see this thing again.
scripts.translation: 好，明智的選擇。我替你還給他。哇哈哈哈哈...沒想到還能再見到它。

scripts.text: Although you're a human, you're an Orc Hero amongst us now, so you should have a helm suitable for your position...
scripts.translation: 雖然你是人類，但現在你也是我們中的獸人英雄，所以你應該有一頂符合你身份的頭盔...

scripts.text: There you go. I marked a small indication on it. So wear this helm from now on. Do you understand? My human Orc Hero.
scripts.translation: 拿著，我在上面做了個小記號。今後就戴這頂。明白嗎，人類的獸人英雄？

scripts.text: Hm, are you the human who was granted status as an Orc Hero?
scripts.translation: 嗯，你就是那個被授予獸人英雄身份的人類嗎？

scripts.text: I hope you know the meaning of returning my Emblem. I expect that we will meet again on the battlefield.
scripts.translation: 希望你明白，歸還我的獸人英雄之證，意味著什麼。期待在戰場上再次相遇。

scripts.text: Hm, are you the human that was granted status as an Orc Hero?
scripts.translation: 嗯，你是那個被授予獸人英雄稱號的人類嗎？

scripts.text: Hmpf, I'm not convinced. Are you really the one who gave us our Emblems back? I don't think I can trust you...
scripts.translation: 哼，我不信。你真的是把徽章還給我們的人嗎？我覺得我沒法信任你...

scripts.text: Yeh, you would think I'd remember getting whupped by an ugly human, but I tend not to remember faces when I'm too busy getting whomped on.
scripts.translation: 是啊，你肯定以為我會記得被一個醜陋的人類揍了一頓，但我忙著捱揍的時候，通常記不住臉。

scripts.text: Let's meet outside west of the forest, and I'll test your strength again!
scripts.translation: 來吧！到森林西邊去，我再試試你的實力！
